title: More room for your board
items: A slimmer Vision header gives your board more space. Your project name and save status stay at the top.
The hamburger menu stays in the same place in Vision and Venture. Both side menus have the same width.
Vision’s existing actions now have smaller icons and clear text labels in the side menu.
The header stays open while idle. Swipe it up or work on the board to hide it; the hamburger and animated chevron stay within reach.
Tap outside a menu to return to your workspace. Escape works too.
Open What’s new beside the version or from either side menu. These notes appear once after sign-in for each update on this device.
Dock the tool belt on the left or right without covering nodes. Hold its handle and drag toward an edge, or use the dock button.
Pin tools open, or leave them on Auto. After you choose a tool and use the board, the belt folds away with a scrolling icon animation. Tap the tools button to reopen it.
Your profile is now at the bottom of both workspace menus. Update your photo, API key and account settings from Vision or Venture.
